source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The appearance test creates waitForPrefChange for mailnews.default_sort_order==1 before clicking the ascending control, then awaits that promise. It separately checks that previously opened folders retain their stored flags until Apply is used. The patch also scrolls controls to block:end to avoid the sticky search overlay and resizes the outer window. These are distinct state and receiver contracts. No preference/browser or native resize test ran.
title: Preference tests wait for the changed value before checking downstream state
